Part of the [pycyxwiz API reference](index.md), pycyxwiz 0.2.0: each name with the signature and description the module itself reports. Types are shown without the `pycyxwiz.` prefix; `Sequence[int]` is any list or tuple of integers.

## Functions

| Function | What it does |
|---|---|
| `cuda_available() -> bool` | Check if CUDA is available |
| `get_available_devices() -> list[DeviceInfo]` | Get list of all available devices |
| `get_device(type: DeviceType, device_id: int = 0) -> Device` | Get a device by type and ID |
| `get_version() -> str` | Get version string |
| `initialize() -> bool` | Initialize the CyxWiz backend |
| `metal_available() -> bool` | Check if Metal is available |
| `oneapi_available() -> bool` | Check if oneAPI is available |
| `opencl_available() -> bool` | Check if OpenCL is available |
| `set_device(device: Device) -> None` | Set the active device |
| `shutdown() -> None` | Shutdown the CyxWiz backend |

## Enumerations

- `DataType`: `Float32`, `Float64`, `Int32`, `Int64`, `UInt8`
- `DeviceActivationStage`: `NotStarted`, `BackendSelection`, `DeviceSelection`, `ExecutionValidation`, `EffectiveStateQuery`, `Complete`
- `DeviceIdentityConfidence`: `Unknown`, `BackendLocal`, `ProviderReported`, `StableHardware`
- `DeviceKind`: `Unknown`, `CPU`, `GPU`, `Accelerator`
- `DeviceMetadataStatus`: `NotQueried`, `Available`, `Unsupported`, `Failed`
- `DeviceType`: `CPU`, `CUDA`, `OPENCL`, `ONEAPI`, `METAL`, `VULKAN`

### `Tensor`

Multi-dimensional array with GPU/CPU acceleration support

| Member | What it does |
|---|---|
| `Tensor(self: Tensor) -> None` | Create an empty tensor |
| `Tensor(self: Tensor, shape: Sequence[int], dtype: DataType = DataType.Float32) -> None` | Create a tensor with given shape and data type |
| `__add__(self: Tensor, other: object) -> Tensor` | `a + b`. Element-wise addition |
| `__eq__(self: Tensor, other: object) -> object` | `a == b`. Equality comparison |
| `__ge__(self: Tensor, other: object) -> Tensor` | `a >= b`. Greater-or-equal comparison |
| `__gt__(self: Tensor, other: object) -> Tensor` | `a > b`. Greater-than comparison |
| `__le__(self: Tensor, other: object) -> Tensor` | `a <= b`. Less-or-equal comparison |
| `__lt__(self: Tensor, other: object) -> Tensor` | `a < b`. Less-than comparison |
| `__mul__(self: Tensor, other: object) -> Tensor` | `a * b`. Element-wise multiplication |
| `__ne__(self: Tensor, other: object) -> object` | `a != b`. Inequality comparison |
| `__neg__(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | `-a`. Negate tensor values |
| `__pow__(self: Tensor, exponent: object) -> Tensor` | `a ** b`. Raise tensor values to a power |
| `__radd__(self: Tensor, scalar: float) -> Tensor` | `b + a`. Scalar addition |
| `__repr__(self: Tensor) -> str` | `repr(a)`. |
| `__rmul__(self: Tensor, scalar: float) -> Tensor` | `b * a`. Scalar multiplication |
| `__rsub__(self: Tensor, scalar: float) -> Tensor` | `b - a`. Scalar subtraction |
| `__rtruediv__(self: Tensor, scalar: float) -> Tensor` | `b / a`. Scalar divided by each element |
| `__sub__(self: Tensor, other: object) -> Tensor` | `a - b`. Element-wise subtraction |
| `__truediv__(self: Tensor, other: object) -> Tensor` | `a / b`. Element-wise division |
| `abs(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Element-wise absolute value |
| `at(self: Tensor, *args) -> float` | Read an element as float |
| `batch_matmul(self: Tensor, other: Tensor) -> Tensor` | 3D batched matrix multiplication |
| `broadcast_shape(shape1: Sequence[int], shape2: Sequence[int]) -> list[int]` | Compute broadcasted shape |
| `broadcast_to(self: Tensor, target_shape: Sequence[int]) -> Tensor` | Broadcast tensor to a target shape |
| `cat(tensors: Sequence[Tensor], dim: int = 0) -> Tensor` | Concatenate tensors along a dimension |
| `chunk(self: Tensor, chunks: int, dim: int = 0) -> list[Tensor]` | Split tensor into chunks |
| `clip(self: Tensor, min_val: float, max_val: float) -> Tensor` | Clip values to a range |
| `cos(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Element-wise cosine (radians) |
| `dot(self: Tensor, other: Tensor) -> Tensor` | 1D dot product |
| `exp(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Element-wise exponential |
| `expand(self: Tensor, target_shape: Sequence[int]) -> Tensor` | Materialize tensor expanded to a target shape |
| `flatten(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Flatten all dimensions |
| `flatten(self: Tensor, start_dim: int, end_dim: int = -1) -> Tensor` | Flatten a selected dimension range |
| `from_numpy(array: numpy.ndarray) -> Tensor` | Create a Tensor from a NumPy array |
| `full(shape: Sequence[int], value: float, dtype: DataType = DataType.Float32) -> Tensor` | Create a tensor filled with one value |
| `get_data_type(self: Tensor) -> DataType` | Get the data type |
| `get_device(self: Tensor) -> Device` | Get the device this tensor is on |
| `index_select(self: Tensor, dim: int, indices: Sequence[int]) -> Tensor` | Gather indices along one dimension |
| `is_broadcastable(shape1: Sequence[int], shape2: Sequence[int]) -> bool` | Check whether shapes can broadcast |
| `log(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Element-wise natural log |
| `logical_not(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Logical not |
| `max(self: Tensor, dim: object = None, keepdim: bool = False) -> Tensor` | Reduce tensor values by maximum |
| `mean(self: Tensor, dim: object = None, keepdim: bool = False) -> Tensor` | Reduce tensor values by mean |
| `min(self: Tensor, dim: object = None, keepdim: bool = False) -> Tensor` | Reduce tensor values by minimum |
| `num_bytes(self: Tensor) -> int` | Get total size in bytes |
| `num_dimensions(self: Tensor) -> int` | Get number of dimensions |
| `num_elements(self: Tensor) -> int` | Get total number of elements |
| `ones(shape: Sequence[int], dtype: DataType = DataType.Float32) -> Tensor` | Create a tensor filled with ones |
| `permute(self: Tensor, dims: Sequence[int]) -> Tensor` | Reorder dimensions |
| `pow(self: Tensor, exponent: object) -> Tensor` | Raise tensor values to a power |
| `prod(self: Tensor, dim: object = None, keepdim: bool = False) -> Tensor` | Reduce tensor values by product |
| `random(shape: Sequence[int], dtype: DataType = DataType.Float32, seed: int \| None = None) -> Tensor` | Create a tensor with random values [0, 1). Without a seed it draws from the run's random stream (seeded by the training run's model seed); with a seed the same seed gives the same values |
| `range_n(shape: Sequence[int], dtype: DataType = DataType.Float32) -> Tensor` | Create a tensor filled with row-major sequential values |
| `reshape(self: Tensor, shape: Sequence[int]) -> Tensor` | Return a tensor with a new shape |
| `set(self: Tensor, *args) -> None` | Set an element from a float value |
| `shape(self: Tensor) -> list[int]` | Get the shape of the tensor |
| `sign(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Element-wise sign |
| `sin(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Element-wise sine (radians) |
| `slice(self: Tensor, dim: int, start: int, end: int = -1, step: int = 1) -> Tensor` | Slice a tensor along one dimension |
| `split(self: Tensor, split_size: int, dim: int = 0) -> list[Tensor]` | Split tensor by fixed size |
| `split(self: Tensor, sizes: Sequence[int], dim: int = 0) -> list[Tensor]` | Split tensor by explicit sizes |
| `sqrt(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Element-wise square root |
| `squeeze(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Remove all singleton dimensions |
| `squeeze(self: Tensor, dim: int) -> Tensor` | Remove a singleton dimension when its size is one |
| `stack(tensors: Sequence[Tensor], dim: int = 0) -> Tensor` | Stack tensors along a new dimension |
| `std(self: Tensor, dim: object = None, keepdim: bool = False) -> Tensor` | Reduce tensor values by population standard deviation |
| `sum(self: Tensor, dim: object = None, keepdim: bool = False) -> Tensor` | Reduce tensor values |
| `to_numpy(self: Tensor) -> numpy.ndarray` | Convert Tensor to NumPy array (Note: data must be on CPU) |
| `transpose(self: Tensor) -> Tensor` | Transpose a 2D tensor |
| `transpose(self: Tensor, dim0: int, dim1: int) -> Tensor` | Swap two dimensions |
| `unsqueeze(self: Tensor, dim: int) -> Tensor` | Insert a singleton dimension |
| `var(self: Tensor, dim: object = None, keepdim: bool = False) -> Tensor` | Reduce tensor values by population variance |
| `view(self: Tensor, shape: Sequence[int]) -> Tensor` | Alias for reshape semantics |
| `zeros(shape: Sequence[int], dtype: DataType = DataType.Float32) -> Tensor` | Create a tensor filled with zeros |
